title: Feno MC
description: Vanilla+ made by a Minecraft veteran!
body:
## 💫 Feno MC
Feno MC is a vanilla+ modpack that keeps the core gameplay fully intact while adding smooth, simple and fun upgrades. It focuses on improving your quality of life and world atmosphere without breaking farms, redstone, or core vanilla mechanics.

## 🔑 Key Features
✅ Fully compatible with vanilla farms, redstone, and automation
  
✅ Pre Installed Shaders, Can always be turned off by pressing O.
  
✅ Small mods that add up, like Ambient Sounds, Animal Feeding Trough, Better Hoes and more.
  
✅ Custom End dimension with more biomes, Custom Ender Dragon and custom Ender Eyes to get to the End.
  
✅ A few custom crafts that regularly do not exist, like wool to string and craftable sea lanterns.
  
✅ No bloat: no overmodded features, no weird extra game systems


## ❓ Why Play Feno MC?
If you want Minecraft to feel more alive, more beautiful, and more satisfying to build in, but still want all your vanilla strategies, this is the pack. Perfect for builders, survival players, redstoners, or anyone who loves the original Minecraft feel with a few upgrades.

## ❗ Critical Information

Intended Use: Client-side & server-side

No cheats, hacks, or game-breaking features included
